notes.title: We announced a new game!
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730680/Table_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/6691db90b0153e2e6f0e77167e57e1cc108f4dab.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]A turn-based strategy game where all units are tabletop figurines that you need to physically knock over. No health points, no stats, just physics at its best (and worst!)[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/a4d8e654b8566de87d4d7eae2adb9802473ca0c8.gif"][/img][/p][p]“Table Tactics” is a unique blend of strategy and physics, played with little miniature figurines. Imagine you are staring at your kitchen table where you laid out a little fantasy diorama and carefully placed miniatures to defend your castle. Alas, enemy units are coming from all directions! But instead of decreasing their health or worrying about armor, you must physically knock them over by shooting various projectiles (like arrows or marbles), using traps, or pushing them off the table. You’ll need to take the shape and weight of each figurine into consideration.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512859/aecc86eb261155ec1537557b04c9e1cc5fa09847.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Wishlist Now:[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730680/Table_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: What Next? Let us know!
notes.content:
Hello dear products! We hope you enjoyed the game - we laughed, we cried, we even seduced the leaves. So the question rises - what happens next? 

Should we keep adding new updates, new DLCs, new ways of exploiting your attention? Or maybe just move onto new and greater things? 

[h2][b]What would YOU like to see next?[/b][/h2]

(a) Nothing - The game is perfect, let it be and move onto something new!
(b) Expanded Horde Mode - longer levels, more enemies, new upgrades, new environments, etc.
(c) New campaign - new set of levels with new gameplay mechanics and challenges
(d) More ads - yup
(e) Something else? - let us know in comments!

[b]Comment away![/b]

notes.title: PAX In-person Showcase Retrospective & Photos!
notes.content:
Heya!

We just wrapped up showing the game in-person for the first time at PAX West in Seattle (and undoubtedly, some of you reading this, came here from the event). It was a 4 day showcase where we brought two TVs to have two stations playing the custom demo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796919/c6010afe7029aee41807ee06d424571822d19942.jpg[/img]

We had fun decorating the booth and getting in the spirit with some cosplaying as the titular blower guy and the leaves themselves:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796919/24593e5ed074c47aea4d8f26f79ef2078dcd8512.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796919/b3219701540153a96d892aa6fd21a603256d327f.jpg[/img]

As you may notice, there was a palpable [i]lack of chairs[/i], so our feet and legs are killing us now! BUT - it was so great watching folks play the game, laugh at our dumb jokes, and just enjoy our creation. If you're one of those folks - thank YOU so much for coming by and checking the game out :D 

As a side note, we were also showcasing a DIFFERENT game at the same time, at an adjacent Seattle Indies Expo! It was the first time we had two different games at two different shows happening at once, so logistics were a bit nuts and involved scooting a whole-ass TV between buildings (in case you doubted how "indie" we really are): 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796919/db690e5de698c5939496255ea18124d197f35928.jpg[/img]

If you're curious about the other game - you play as a cute crow, fly around the city, poop on people, and steal all their shiny trinkets. So another "jerk-like", but of more cute and wholesome vibe. You can check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537920/Just_Crow_Things/

Aaaaanyway - we will now hermit for a few days to recover and then go back to wrapping up the game and announcing the release date real soon (HYPE). I will leave you with some googly eyes leaf blower:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43796919/5e78a9f0a5ad97bb3da27daa505cd07bfd131ae3.jpg[/img]

Cheers,
Jakub
[i]Chief Leafblower Specialist
Unbound Creations[/i]
